pages.text: There are four major categories of weapons that can be made using materials obtained from the Risus. $(br)$(br)First are Heavy Axes, which are more specialized for combat than base axes, at the cost of their normal utilities. They are more unwieldy but can hit harder in return, while retaining their ability to crush shields. Examples include: $(l:weapons/killjoy)$(c)$(o)Killjoy$(), Unawaked Vessel and Crescent Disaster

Unawaked Vessel and Crescent Disaster. $(br)$(br)Scythes $(br)$(br)Knuckledusters are weapons that inflict a relatively low amount of damage and have a lower range, but in return are much faster to use. Additionally, they enable the user to easily perform a 'lunge' into the direction they are looking, which can be useful for both offense - to enter close combat - and defense - to retreat in haste. Examples include $(l:weapons/toothknocker)$(c)$(o)Toothknocker$() and $(l:weapons/stripper)$(c)$(o)Stripper$().     $(br)$(br)War Swords - similarly to Heavy Axes - are a larger version of normal swords, boasting of higher damage and increased range, at the price of manoeuvrability. Additionally, they often have one way or another to perform a ranged attack. Examples include: $(l:weapons/thousand_blade)$(c)$(o)Blade of a Thousand$() and Compensatory Sin.
